abi: function registerMedia(bytes32 hash, string sourceName, string editHistory) external
function registerVersion(bytes32 parentHash, bytes32 newHash, string sourceName, string versionNote) external
function verifyMedia(bytes32 hash) external view returns (bool exists, address publisher, string sourceName, uint256 timestamp, string editHistory, bytes32 parentHash)
event MediaRegistered(bytes32 indexed hash, address indexed publisher, string sourceName, uint256 timestamp)
event MediaVersionRegistered(bytes32 indexed hash, bytes32 indexed parentHash, address indexed publisher, uint256 timestamp)
